home.title: Project ready!
home.intro: You may now add components and start building.
home.componentNote: We've already added the button component for you.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: Manage staff members and their weekly availability.
staff.emptyDescription: Add your first staff member to start building schedules.
staff.newDescription: Add staff details and weekly availability.
staff.editDescription: Update staff details and weekly availability.

form.detailsDescription: These fields describe the staff member.
form.availabilityDescription: Leave a day empty when the staff member is not available that day.

detail.groupsDescription: Groups this staff member can be scheduled in.
detail.availabilityHoursMismatch: Available hours total {availableHours}h, but max hours per week is {maxHours}h.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Manage groups and their minimum staffing rules.
groups.emptyDescription: Add your first group to define staffing needs.
groups.newDescription: Add a group name and weekly staff rules.
groups.editDescription: Update the group name and staff rules.

form.name: Name
form.rulesDescription: Add the minimum staffing needed for each weekday time range. Every rule must fit within one opening-hours interval.
form.applyRulesToAllWeekdays: Apply the same rules to all weekdays
form.applyRulesToAllWeekdaysDescription: Edit one shared set of rules that will be saved separately for Monday through Friday.

detail.subtitle: Minimum staffing rules
detail.staffDescription: Active staff members linked to this group.
detail.noStaff: No staff members have been linked.
detail.allStaffLinked: All active staff members are already linked.
detail.noRules: No staff rules have been added.
detail.totalCapacityShortfall: This group is short {hours} staff hours this week based on current staffing rules and linked staff capacity.
detail.pedagogCapacityShortfall: This group is short {hours} pedagog hours this week based on current staffing rules and linked pedagog staff capacity.

openingHours.title: Institution opening hours
openingHours.description: Configure the global hours when shifts may be scheduled. Add multiple intervals for split opening hours, or leave a day closed. Existing staffing rules must remain inside one interval.

shiftSchedule.title: Shift schedule
shiftSchedule.description: Preview the opening hours and group data used to generate a shift schedule.
shiftSchedule.savedPlansDescription: Read-only plans from the former weekday generator. They do not have actual dates or publication status.
shiftSchedule.savedPlansEmptyDescription: New dated schedules are created in Planning.
shiftSchedule.savedPlanDetailDescription: Read-only legacy weekday shifts and generation metadata. This is not a dated official schedule.
shiftSchedule.emptyDescription: Choose a group to preview linked staff, availability, and staff rules as JSON.
shiftSchedule.noGroups: Create a group before previewing shift schedule data.
shiftSchedule.generatedDescription: Generate a preview plan from institution opening hours and the selected group's staff, availability, and staffing rules.
shiftSchedule.generatedEmptyDescription: Generate a plan to see validated AI output here.
shiftSchedule.calendarDescription: Shift placement and duration on a shared timeline.
shiftSchedule.invalidGroup: The selected group id is not valid. Choose a group from the list.
shiftSchedule.groupNotFound: That group could not be found. Choose another group from the list.

planning.title: Planning
planning.description: Prepare dated schedules, review staffing coverage, and publish an official version.
planning.noGroupsDescription: Create a group and add staff before starting a dated schedule.
planning.groupDescription: Each schedule covers one inclusive date range. Published versions remain available in history.
planning.periodsDescription: Continue a draft or open an official published schedule.
planning.noPeriodsForGroup: No periods have been prepared for this group.
planning.inclusiveDatesDescription: Every date in the range is included. The draft is generated fresh from current settings and exceptions.
planning.dateRangeError: The end date must be on or after the start date.
planning.timeRangeError: The end time must be after the start time.
planning.sourceOwnershipDescription: These records remain attached to their institution, group, or staff owner.
planning.noExceptionsAffecting: No dated exceptions affect this range.
planning.saveToReviewInputs: Save the date range to load current settings and relevant exceptions before generation.
planning.planningStaffDescription: Open a staff record to review recurring availability and staff-owned exceptions.
planning.preparationInputsChanged: Relevant settings or owner records changed after this preparation was reviewed. Refresh inputs before generation.
planning.discardDraftDescription: Discard this working draft? Published versions and their history remain unchanged.
planning.inputsChanged: Relevant settings, exceptions, or published commitments changed. Refresh inputs and review the resulting validation before publishing.
planning.lockedShiftHelp: Unlock this shift before changing or deleting it.
planning.manualEditHelp: Manual changes save directly to the working draft and run validation again.
planning.shiftLabel: Shift from {start} to {end} ({duration}). Drag to move; drag either edge to resize.
planning.aiPlaceholder: For example: cover the late afternoon without moving locked shifts.
planning.confirmAiScope: I confirm that AI may propose changes across this {scope}.
planning.aiWorking: Building an isolated proposal. The draft stays unchanged while you wait.
planning.proposalUnchanged: {count} proposed changes · the draft is unchanged
planning.proposalStale: This proposal is stale because the draft or relevant inputs changed. Discard it and request a new proposal.
planning.proposalValid: The proposed schedule passes current deterministic validation.
planning.exceptionOwnerDescription: This record belongs to the {owner} and affects every relevant schedule.
planning.sameDayHint: Leave empty for a single day.
planning.pedagogMinimumError: Minimum pedagogs cannot exceed minimum staff.
planning.countsTowardHours: Count this attendance toward weekly hours
planning.participantsDescription: Select every staff member attending this shared event.
planning.participantRequired: Select at least one participant for this shared event.
planning.dateOutsidePeriod: This date is outside the planning period.
planning.noOwnerExceptions: No planning exceptions are recorded here.
planning.groupExceptionsDescription: Record dated staffing replacements or shared events for this group. Relevant periods pick them up automatically.
planning.staffExceptionsDescription: Record leave, sickness, partial unavailability, meetings, or training on this staff record.
planning.institutionExceptionsDescription: Record closures, replacement opening intervals, or institution-wide shared events.
planning.commitmentsChecked: Other groups and counted attendance checked
planning.publishDescription: Publishing creates an immutable official version. Later edits use a separate draft revision.
planning.changesFromOfficial: Compared with the current official version.
planning.changesFromGeneration: Compared with the accepted generated draft.
planning.noDraftChanges: No shift changes since the comparison version.
planning.loadErrorTitle: Planning data could not be loaded
planning.loadErrorDescription: The saved planning data is temporarily unavailable. Try again, or return to the planning overview.

issues.minStaff: Minimum staff coverage is not met.
issues.minPedagogs: Minimum pedagog coverage is not met.
issues.availability: A shift falls outside the staff member's effective availability.
issues.hours: Weekly hours exceed the configured maximum.
issues.overlap: This staff member has overlapping shifts.
issues.external: This shift conflicts with an official schedule in another group.
issues.opening: A shift falls outside effective opening hours.
issues.fifo: Shift end order breaks the configured FIFO rule.
issues.stale: The reviewed proposal no longer matches current inputs.
issues.period: The planning period has an invalid date range.
issues.ruleOutsideOpening: A recurring staffing rule extends outside effective opening hours.
issues.conflictingReplacement: Overlapping dated replacements conflict with each other.
issues.replacementOutsideOpening: A dated staffing replacement extends outside effective opening hours.
issues.eventOverlap: Counted events overlap for a participant.
issues.capacity: Available staff hours may not cover this group's demand.
issues.pedagogCapacity: Available pedagog hours may not cover this group's demand.
issues.otherDraft: An unpublished schedule in another group may compete for this staff member.
issues.inactive: A shift references an inactive staff member.
issues.unknownStaff: A shift references a staff member who is no longer available.
issues.invalidTime: A shift has an invalid time interval.

errors.invalidRequest: Some submitted values are invalid. Check the dates, times, owner, and participants.
errors.staleRevision: The draft changed in another session. Reload it before saving again.
errors.staleSource: This source record changed in another session. Reload it before saving again.
errors.staleUndo: Your last edit can no longer be undone because the draft changed.
errors.overlappingPeriod: This date range overlaps another active period for the group.
errors.validationFailed: Resolve the current schedule errors before continuing.
errors.staleInputs: Relevant settings or owner records changed. Refresh and review current inputs before continuing.
errors.staleProposal: The proposal no longer matches the current draft or inputs.
errors.proposalMissing: This proposal is no longer available.
errors.proposalClosed: This proposal has already been applied or discarded.
